sentence: This project provides tissue and blood samples from lymphoma patients to researchers and helps clinical trials by reviewing tissue and doing staining tests.
This project studies the structure of calcium-activated cation channels to find out how they are switched on and blocked.
This project studies whether patients with liver cancer carry rare inherited gene variants more often than people in control populations.
This project builds artificial intelligence methods that use health record, imaging and wearable device data to give personalized support for diabetes management.
This project studies a way to correct the disease gene in blood stem cells, aiming at less toxic gene therapy for sickle cell anemia.
This project provides data analysis services for cancer research, using standardized pipelines for next-generation sequencing and mining public datasets.
This project studies how the immune system allows or protects against malignant transformation of precursors to multiple myeloma, using mouse models.
This project tests whether a rapid blood or urine test can detect sugars circulating in the blood of critically ill patients with sepsis.
This project builds a center that coordinates large and complex data sets to show how genes cause neurological illness.
This project studies when and why sleep differences arise between socioeconomic and racial groups and how sleep problems affect health into early adulthood.
This project studies how low oxygen helps hematopoietic stem cells work through gene expression and metabolic control.
This project studies how the endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondria interact to drive metabolism in colorectal cancer cells.
This project combines cancer cell analysis and medical imaging with artificial intelligence to improve targeted therapies and tumor monitoring for children with low-grade gliomas.
This project develops drug-free therapies that recruit and activate T cells against malignant B cells.
This project builds tools and databases to help researchers study small regulatory RNAs found in human and mouse sequencing data.
This project tests a treatment using dendritic cells to reactivate the latent HIV reservoir and help the immune system remove it.
This project edits cell lines from patients with genetic lung diseases and makes lentiviral constructs for use in other projects.
This project uses machine learning to predict smoking quitting outcomes and daily lapse risk in adults trying to quit smoking.
This project works to improve the chemistry of fluorosequencing, a method that reads peptide sequences at the single molecule level.
This project designs and builds a small automated instrument that counts stem cells in human tissue cell samples.
